findings.body: This test stops after verifying that percentage alone is offered a period; it never chooses that period and verifies the required successful answer with a not-loaded budget state and null percentage cell. The side-by-side flow similarly lacks a continuation for a month with no budget batch. Consequently, a regression that offers the correct options but mishandles the continuation or fails to produce the required dashes would pass the suite.
findings.title: Not done: no-budget comparison continuations

findings.body: The test injects the exact zero-valued result it later asserts, without establishing that CHIR has no actual rows while another plant does. It therefore only proves that ChatService returns a mocked row and would still pass if the real statement execution stopped zero-filling a chosen plant with no rows. The required flow needs a fixture or real execution boundary that distinguishes the rowless chosen plant from the plant supplying the offered period.
findings.title: Not done: statement plant with no rows test

findings.body: The declared scope permits changes only to the three chat files, but this branch also adds a task-tracking JSON file. It is not needed by the comparison-period runtime or its tests and should be removed from the selected change to keep the task within its approved scope.
findings.title: Remove the out-of-scope Forge task-state file
